shell.footerNote: Analysis identity and measurements stay independent of display language.

workspace.title: Analysis Workspace
workspace.intro: Draw one area of interest, choose an inclusive Gregorian date range, submit an analysis, and review its saved result.
workspace.mapDescription: Draw a single polygon on the map. Geographic orientation stays fixed in every language.
workspace.mapNotReady: The interactive map is not ready yet.
workspace.mapFailure: The map or polygon drawing control could not be loaded. Area drawing is unavailable.
workspace.mapFailureDetail: Check the map connection and reload this page.
workspace.mapAttribution: Basemap: a minimal style hosted by this app (background and a reference graticule only). M1 uses no external map tile, vector or raster data provider; the map's own attribution control names this self-hosted style. Adding an external basemap provider is a later, separately recorded decision.
workspace.mapControlResetBearing: Drag to rotate the map, click to reset north
workspace.mapGestureHintWindows: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
workspace.mapGestureHintMac: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the map
workspace.mapGestureHintMobile: Use two fingers to move the map
workspace.drawingHelp: Click map points to draw. Double-click to finish the polygon.
workspace.areaDrawn: One polygon is ready for validation.
workspace.coordinateInstructions: For keyboard entry, paste one GeoJSON Polygon or Feature containing one polygon. Closed outer and hole rings are supported. Coordinates use longitude, latitude order.
workspace.dateHelp: Gregorian calendar dates, inclusive, and no more than 120 days apart. The service interval uses UTC.
workspace.notSubmittedDetail: No analysis request has been sent.
workspace.analysisFailed: The backend reported a failed run.
workspace.failedRunHasNoEvidenceStatus: No evidence status is shown for a failed run.
workspace.failedRunNoResult: This failed run has no result payload. See the failure reason in the execution panel.
workspace.evidenceNotAssessed: Evidence status: not assessed under the M1 method.
workspace.evidenceInsufficient: Evidence status: insufficient; no observation date yielded a scientifically usable NDVI result.
workspace.unsupportedEvidenceStatus: The backend returned {status}, which is outside the frozen M1 evidence outcomes.
workspace.unknownEvidenceStatus: The backend did not return a recognized evidence status.
workspace.pollingTimedOut: The status check reached its time limit. The saved analysis was not resubmitted.
workspace.noResult: No result is available because no saved analysis has been loaded.
workspace.previewReady: The NDVI preview is rendered on the map above as an estimate, colored with the backend's own recorded palette. It is not a substitute for the statistics below.
workspace.previewNotReady: The saved analysis result is not committed yet, so no NDVI preview could be requested.
workspace.previewNotReadyFailed: The saved analysis run failed and has no committed result, so no NDVI preview could be requested. No map layer is shown.
workspace.previewNoArtifact: The backend result contains no ready NDVI preview artifact. No map layer is shown.
workspace.previewArtifactNotReady: The backend has not finished preparing the NDVI preview artifact yet. No map layer is shown.
workspace.previewUrlUnavailable: The NDVI preview artifact is ready, but the backend provided no fetchable image URL for it. No map layer is shown.
workspace.previewFetchFailed: The NDVI preview image could not be fetched from the backend. No map layer is shown.
workspace.previewResultUnavailable: The saved analysis result could not be fetched from the backend. No map layer is shown.
workspace.previewNotConfigured: The NDVI preview relay is not configured on this deployment. No map layer is shown.
workspace.previewDecodeFailed: The NDVI preview image could not be decoded in this browser. No map layer is shown.
workspace.previewCrsUnsupported: The NDVI preview's coordinate system is not supported for map placement in this browser. No map layer is shown.
workspace.notScientificThreshold: workload guard, not a scientific threshold
workspace.statisticsUnavailable: The result contains no AOI-level NDVI statistics.
workspace.qualityEvidenceDescription: Coverage by evaluated acquisition date, plus the recorded processing baseline and rejection counts.
workspace.coverageChartLabel: Valid AOI coverage by evaluated acquisition date
workspace.coverageChartUnavailable: No evaluated acquisition dates were returned.
workspace.qualityEvidenceDisclosure: Bars show returned coverage only; they are not a quality score, ranking, or scientific suitability claim.
workspace.resultBlocked: The saved analysis could not be loaded. See the execution status above.
workspace.scoringNotScored: This result was not scored under method aq-scorecard-1. Priority scoring does not apply to it.
workspace.scoringUncalibratedDisclosure: Decision support for field verification — not enforcement, not a confirmed diagnosis. The evidence-quality class is an uncalibrated rule-based class, not a priority class.
workspace.scoringNoZones: The result carries no zone assessment.
workspace.scoringZoneUnranked: Unranked — see the reason below; no class is shown
workspace.resultTimedOut: The saved result is still unavailable. Check status again to continue.
workspace.provenanceUnavailable: Coverage and provenance facts appear here after a real result is loaded.
workspace.workspaceDisclosure: This workspace does not calculate or simulate satellite analysis in the browser.

settings.title: Settings / Data Sources
settings.description: Read-only status returned by the backend for its allowlisted data sources.
settings.loadingDetail: Reading the backend's recorded source status…
settings.noSources: The backend returned no configured source records.
settings.settingsDisclosure: A reachable catalogue does not establish pixel access, AOI coverage, or scientific suitability. Provider credentials and source configuration remain in reviewed backend settings.

errors.invalidGeoJson: The text is not valid GeoJSON.
errors.unsupportedGeometry: Use one Polygon with one outer ring. MultiPolygon and holes are not supported.
errors.invalidCoordinates: Coordinates must be finite longitude and latitude pairs within WGS84 bounds.
errors.invalidPolygon: The polygon must be closed, have positive area, and not cross itself.
errors.antimeridianUnsupported: Polygons crossing the 180° meridian are not supported.
errors.tooManyVertices: The polygon exceeds the 500 vertex limit.
errors.areaTooLarge: The polygon exceeds the 5,000 km² request limit.
errors.dateMissing: Choose both a start date and an end date.
errors.dateOrder: The start date must be on or before the end date.
errors.dateSpanTooLong: The inclusive date range cannot exceed 120 days.
errors.INPUT_INVALID: The analysis input was rejected. Review the area and date range.
errors.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The analysis exceeds a configured workload limit.
errors.NOT_READY: The saved result is not ready yet.
errors.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: A required data source is unavailable.
errors.PROCESSING_FAILED: The analysis could not be completed.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This request key was already used with different analysis input.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: The backend requires an authorized session. No analysis was submitted.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This session is not allowed to access the saved analysis.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The saved analysis was not found for this session.
errors.API_NOT_CONFIGURED: The backend API URL is not configured for this web application.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_UNAVAILABLE: This browser could not create a secure request key. No analysis was submitted.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: The backend could not be reached. You can retry this attempt with the same request key.
errors.HTTP_ERROR: The backend returned an error without the frozen machine-readable error envelope.
errors.UNKNOWN_RESPONSE: The backend response did not match the pinned result contract.
errors.unknownBackendError: The service returned an unrecognized error. Reference: {requestId}
errors.unknownBackendReason: The backend reported a failure reason that this web version does not recognize.
errors.unknownBackendLimitation: The backend reported a limitation that this web version does not recognize.
errors.MANDATORY_INPUT_MISSING: A mandatory input for scoring was not available for this zone.
errors.ZONE_FULLY_MASKED: The zone was fully masked, so no valid measurement was possible.
errors.NO_OBSERVATION_IN_WINDOW: No valid observation fell inside the requested date window for this zone.
errors.RESOLUTION_INADEQUATE: The source resolution was too coarse for a zone-level measurement.
errors.AGRI_MASK_BLOCKED: The agricultural mask was not accepted, so the zone could not be scored.
errors.NOT_AGRICULTURAL: The zone contains no accepted agricultural area.
errors.PERSISTENCE_INELIGIBLE: Persistence is not eligible for ranking for this zone.
errors.PERSISTENCE_CAUSE_NO_COMPATIBLE_BASELINE: No compatible seasonal baseline is available.
errors.PERSISTENCE_CAUSE_EXCESSIVE_GAPS: The requested history has excessive gaps.
errors.PERSISTENCE_CAUSE_AGRICULTURAL_MASK_BLOC: Persistence is unavailable until an accepted agricultural mask and compatible baseline are available.
errors.PERSISTENCE_UNKNOWN: Persistence could not be determined for this zone, so it cannot be ranked.
errors.PERSISTENCE_NOT_ASSESSED: Persistence was not assessed for this zone, so it cannot be ranked.
errors.EVIDENCE_LIMITED: The evidence for this zone is limited, so it is not ranked.
errors.EVIDENCE_NOT_ASSESSED: Evidence assessment was not performed for this zone.
errors.INDEPENDENT_SUPPORT: Independent evidence families support this zone's ranking.
errors.PERSISTENT_ANOMALY: A persistent anomaly was measured across the requested window.
errors.RECURRENT_ANOMALY: A recurring anomaly was measured across the requested window.
errors.ANOMALY_STRENGTH: The measured anomaly strength for this zone.
errors.NO_PERSISTENT_ANOMALY: No persistent anomaly was measured for this zone.
errors.TIED_RANK: This zone shares its rank group with other zones that have identical evidence.
errors.PRIORITY_CLASS_NOT_ESTABLISHED: A priority class is not established under this method; only ordering is shown.
errors.HAZE_CLOUD_DUST_MASKED: Part of the zone was masked as haze, cloud or dust.
errors.PROVISIONAL_AOI: The analysis area is provisional and has not been validated as authoritative.
errors.NO_INDEPENDENT_CORROBORATION: No independent evidence family corroborates this zone.
errors.SAME_FAMILY_NOT_INDEPENDENT: Two indicators came from the same optical family, so they count once.
errors.CONTEXT_ONLY_SOURCE: A source was used for context only and cannot confirm a zone measurement.
errors.RESOLUTION_CONTEXT_ONLY: A coarser source was used for context only, not as zone-level evidence.
errors.REVISION_INCOMPATIBLE: A source product revision was incompatible with the comparison baseline.
errors.BASELINE_NOT_SEASON_MATCHED: The seasonal baseline does not match the requested season.
errors.TEMPORAL_GAPS: The observation record has temporal gaps over the requested window.
errors.FACTOR_NOT_APPLICABLE: This scorecard factor does not apply to the zone.
errors.FACTOR_NOT_ASSESSED: This scorecard factor was not assessed for the zone.
errors.unknownSourceReason: The backend returned an unrecognized source-check reason.
errors.NO_ELIGIBLE_ACQUISITION: No evaluated acquisition date qualified for selection.
errors.NO_SCENES_FOUND: The catalogue returned no scenes for this area and date range.
errors.NO_DATE_MEETS_MIN_VALID_COVERAGE: No evaluated date met the backend's configured valid-coverage guard.
errors.LOW_VALID_COVERAGE: The acquisition did not meet the configured valid-coverage guard.
errors.SOURCE_READ_FAILED: A required source tile or band could not be read.
errors.NO_VALID_CANDIDATE: No valid unmasked source pixel was available for this location.
errors.TOO_MANY_TILES_FOR_DATE: The date requires more tiles than the backend's configured processing limit.
errors.BOA_OFFSET_NOT_ASSERTED: The source metadata did not confirm the required BOA offset handling.
errors.NDVI_OUT_OF_RANGE_PIXELS_REJECTED: NDVI pixels outside the valid range were excluded.
errors.NO_VALID_PIXEL_IN_SELECTED_DATE: The selected acquisition yielded no valid NDVI pixel.
errors.EFFECTIVE_QUALITY_RESOLUTION_20M: The effective analysis resolution was 20 m due to a lower-resolution source band.
errors.UNREACHABLE: The backend could not reach the catalogue during this recorded check.
errors.UNEXPECTED_STATUS: The catalogue returned an unexpected response during this recorded check.
errors.draftStorageUnavailable: This browser could not preserve the current draft. Keep this tab open while changing languages.
